$comment: Hand-curated rates for models whose provider API publishes no machine-readable price. Keyed by model key (`<provider>:<owner>/<name>`). Tier keys: `<resolution>` or `*` (any resolution), optionally followed by `:video_in` (Replicate's dearer video-input variant), `:audio` or `:silent` (a with- or without-audio rate), all lower-case. Copy each rate from the `current_tiers` block on the model's public page (`source`), set `checked` to the day you did, and re-check before every release. A rate the provider's own API publishes (OpenRouter `pricing_skus`) always wins over an entry here.

replicate:bytedance/seedance-2.5.note: Per second of output video; the dearer tier applies when the run has a video input.

replicate:bytedance/seedance-2.0.note: Per second of output video; the dearer tier applies when the run has a video input.

replicate:google/nano-banana-2.note: Per output image, by target resolution.

replicate:google/nano-banana-pro.note: Per output image, by target resolution.

replicate:google/veo-3.1.note: Per second of output video; the dearer tier applies when the run generates audio.

replicate:google/veo-3.1-fast.note: Per second of output video; the dearer tier applies when the run generates audio.

replicate:minimax/hailuo-2.3.note: Replicate bills per output video ($0.28 for 6 s and $0.56 for 10 s at 768p, $0.49 for 6 s at 1080p); quoted per second at the dearer rate for each resolution, so a 6 s 768p run is over-quoted.

replicate:prunaai/p-video.note: Per second of output video; draft mode bills a quarter of this, which is not modelled.

replicate:black-forest-labs/flux-2-pro.note: Per output image: $0.015 per run plus $0.015 per output megapixel, by target resolution. Input images add $0.015 per megapixel, which is not included.

replicate:openai/gpt-image-2.note: Per output image at the default (auto) or high quality; low ($0.012) and medium ($0.047) quality bill less, which is not modelled.

replicate:openai/gpt-image-1.5.note: Per output image at the default (auto) or high quality; low ($0.013) and medium ($0.05) quality bill less, which is not modelled.

replicate:openai/gpt-image-2.5-flare.note: Per output image, quoted at the dearest quality (max) so no run is under-quoted: low $0.012, medium $0.047, high $0.128, auto (the default) and xhigh $0.25, max $0.50. Quality is not modelled, so a default run is over-quoted.

replicate:openai/gpt-image-2.5-sunburst.note: Per output image, quoted at the dearest quality (max) so no run is under-quoted: low $0.012, medium $0.047, high $0.128, auto (the default) and xhigh $0.25, max $0.50. Quality is not modelled, so a default run is over-quoted.
